basic_info.description: Welcome to this class of its own home! All of your senses will be enthralled with sunset views of the ocean, spacious landscaping,Lutron light switches,Nest thermostat, smartphone capabilities for remote operation and key-code doorlocking systems for maximum convenience. The main living area has cherry hardwood floor tastefully crafted to highlight the kitchen, dining room, living room and hallway. The kitchen is illuminated by skylight and has SS appliances, modern cabinets, brand new range and smart refrigerator is perfectly matched to entertain or order food to your doorstep! The living room offers wood burning fireplace to warm up the foggy days. Updated full marble bathroom has large mirror, double sink, shower over tub, skylight and heating lamp. There are 2 bedrooms on the main level with west-facing views of the ocean, perfect for gazing at the mesmerizing sunsets overlooking the landscaped backyard.Interior stairs lead to the bonus room downstairs that could be used for bedroom/office/gym/entertainment with full bathroom with shower glass cabin, floating vanity, wall heater and closet. This home offers flawless comfort and access to all neighborhood amenities for the enjoyment of your family inside and out with endless possibilities
